_comment_hooks: Delivery-gate enforcement. Everything else in this pipeline can be skipped by an agent that
decides it already knows a report is fine; these cannot. The Stop hook keeps the turn from
ending while a report touched this session has no valid gate receipt, and the PreToolUse hook
refuses to transmit one. See tools/hooks/ and reports/gate.py.
The hooks never judge a report - they verify that the report-auditor and report-editor agents
did, against the exact bytes on disk, on top of a PoC recorded by `hunt poc-run`.
_comment_permissions: The enforcement machinery is not agent-editable. A gate an agent can rewrite is not a gate -
the cheapest bypass of any check is to edit the check. Changing these files is still possible,
it just has to be a deliberate human act outside the session rather than something that happens
mid-task. Everything else in the repo stays freely editable.
